subject: BenefitFlow canonical identity, dedicated repository target, and recursive recovery
body: Canonical project identity is BenefitFlow (project_id=benefitflow). Dedicated repository target is boberino93-bit/benefitflow. Until repository creation and binding are verified, GitHub writes remain blocked. All agents must use BenefitFlow-AgentBus for project communication/evidence/artifacts. Every continuation-capable package must carry a complete checksummed AgentBus snapshot and successor revalidation metadata under the recursive backup/recovery contracts. Cross-project writes are denied.
